summary: Unstable periodic orbit of two side-by-side cylinders at Re = 62 (flip-flop, T = 8.8152) by Newton-GMRES.
description: Flip-flop orbit (unstable periodic orbit) at Re = 62 by Newton-GMRES, started from the Re = 60 snapshot with the period 8.73356. The Newton iteration changes the period; the converged orbit has T = 8.815177, the time stamp of BF_2cyl0.f00001. The final residual must lie below the Newton tolerance 1e-8. The period and the five statistics of BF_2cyl0.f00001 identify the orbit; they are the values of the committed run, which the run of 2026-10-09 on 16 ranks reproduces to 1e-6. An orbit that was shipped in the 311, 321 and 411 stages from an earlier run differs by 5e-7 in the period and by up to 8e-5 in the extrema.

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8).

orbit_period.note: Period of the converged orbit: the time stamp of the base-flow file. The starting value is 8.73356.
